##########################################################################################
SDS-PAGE INTENSITY
##########################################################################################

```{r}
data_SDS <- read.csv("../data/validation_data/260521 Gel1 ULK1 analys.csv", sep=";", header = TRUE, skip=1)
names(data_SDS) <- c('Lane','Band_nr','Relative_front','Adj_vol_int', 'Vol_int', 'Abs_quant', 'Rel_quant', 'X')

data_SDS <- data_SDS %>%
  group_by(Lane) %>%
  summarize(Adj_vol_int = sum(Adj_vol_int)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(Sample = case_when(
    Lane %in% c(2,3,4) ~ "Expi293",
    Lane %in% c(5,6,7) ~ "Expi293_ULK1_KO",
    Lane == 1 ~ "Ladder")
    )

data_SDS
```

# 1. Plot SDS grouped replicates
# 1.1 Statistix: 
```{r}
# 1. Get fold change
FC = mean(data_SDS$Adj_vol_int[data_SDS$Sample == "Expi293_ULK1_KO"]) /
     mean(data_SDS$Adj_vol_int[data_SDS$Sample == "Expi293"])
FC = round(FC,2)

# 2. get pval between Expi293_ULK1_KO & Expi293
p_val <- data_SDS %>%
  filter(Sample != "Ladder") %>%
  t_test(Adj_vol_int ~ Sample,
         comparisons = list(c("Expi293", "Expi293_ULK1_KO"))) %>%
  pull(p)
p_val = round(p_val,4)

# Extract points to plot in barplot (exclude ladder point)
data_SDS_points <- data_SDS %>% filter(Sample != "Ladder")

# 3.Get standard deviation within groups (for error bars)
SDS_stats <- data_SDS %>%
  filter(Sample != "Ladder") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Adj_vol_int),
    sd = sd(Adj_vol_int),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# 1.2 Plot
```{r}
condition_colors <- c("Expi293" = "#9bd1ae", "Expi293_ULK1_KO" = "#98b5eb")
condition_labels <- c("Expi293" = "Expi", "Expi293_ULK1_KO" = "Expi ULK1 KO")

# Function to get nicer y axis labels
y_axis_labeling <- function(x){
  parse(text=gsub("e"," %*% 10^", scales::scientific_format()(x)))
}

SDS_plot <- ggplot(SDS_stats, aes(x = factor(Sample),
                      y = mean,
                      fill = Sample)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           width = 0.75,
           position = position_dodge(0.9),
           alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = data_SDS_points,
             aes(x = factor(Sample), y = Adj_vol_int),
             position = position_jitter(width =0.08),
             color = "black", size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.25) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = y_axis_labeling) + 
  labs(title = "",
     x = " ",
     y = "Adjusted volume intensity")+
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, y = 4500000, xend = 2, yend = 4500000)) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 1.5, y = 4700000, label = paste0("FC: ", FC,"   (", "p=", p_val,")"), hjust = "center", size=3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),    
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14))

pdf(file="../results/validation_experiments/SDS_total_20260825.pdf", height=4, width=2.5)
print(SDS_plot)
dev.off()
```

# 2. Plot and compare LANES AND BANDS
```{r}
data_SDS <- read.csv("../data/validation_data/260521 Gel1 ULK1 analys.csv", sep=";", header = TRUE, skip=1)

           width = 0.8) +
```

# 3. Separate BANDS
```{r}
data_SDS <- read.csv("../data/validation_data/260521 Gel1 ULK1 analys.csv", sep=";", header = TRUE, skip=1)

  mutate(Group = case_when(

SDS_bands_stats <- data_SDS %>%
  group_by(Band_nr, Group) %>%

    mean = mean(Adj_vol_int),
    sd = sd(Adj_vol_int))

SDS_bands_stats
```

```{r}

SDS_bands_pvals
```

##########################################################################################
FIGURE LC3 (Figure 4B)
##########################################################################################

Read in mnormalized data
```{r}
data_LC3 <- read.csv("../data/validation_data/AZ data/LC3 Normalised (2).csv", sep=",", header = TRUE)
data_LC3 <- data_LC3[1:11]
names(data_LC3) <- c('Group', paste0("neg_",1:5), paste0("pos_",1:5)) # Set header names

# Pivot df
data_LC3 <- data_LC3 %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(Group), names_to = "Condition", values_to = "FC") # Pivot longer 

# Fix names
data_LC3$Group <-  sub("Expi\nULK1 KO", "ULK1_KO", data_LC3$Group) # Add sample type
data_LC3$Condition <-  sub("_.*", "", data_LC3$Condition) # Add sample type
data_LC3$Sample_type <-  paste0(data_LC3$Group, "_", data_LC3$Condition)

# Subset to plot
data_LC3_subset <- data_LC3 %>% filter(Sample_type %in% c("Expi_neg","Expi_pos", "ULK1_KO_neg","ULK1_KO_pos"))
data_LC3_subset
```
```{r}
# 1. Get fold changes
FC_WT = mean(data_LC3_subset$FC[data_LC3_subset$Sample_type == "Expi_pos"]) / mean(data_LC3_subset$FC[data_LC3_subset$Sample_type == "Expi_neg"])
FC_KO = mean(data_LC3_subset$FC[data_LC3_subset$Sample_type == "ULK1_KO_pos"]) / mean(data_LC3_subset$FC[data_LC3_subset$Sample_type == "ULK1_KO_neg"])

FC_WT = round(FC_WT,2)
FC_KO = round(FC_KO,2)

# 2. Get pvals
p_WT <- data_LC3_subset %>%
  filter(Sample_type %in% c("Expi_pos","Expi_neg")) %>%
  t_test(FC ~ Sample_type, comparisons = list(c("Expi_pos", "Expi_neg"))) %>% pull(p)
p_WT <- round(p_WT,4)

p_KO <- data_LC3_subset %>%
  filter(Sample_type %in% c("ULK1_KO_pos","ULK1_KO_neg")) %>%
  t_test(FC ~ Sample_type, comparisons = list(c("ULK1_KO_pos", "ULK1_KO_neg"))) %>% pull(p)
p_KO <- round(p_KO,4)

# 3.Get standard deviation within groups (for error bars)
LC3_stats <- data_LC3_subset %>%
  filter(Sample_type %in% c("Expi_pos","Expi_neg", "ULK1_KO_pos","ULK1_KO_neg")) %>%
  group_by(Group, Condition) %>%
  reframe(
    mean = mean(FC),
    sd = sd(FC),
    sem = sd(FC) /sqrt(length(FC)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Expi", "ULK1_KO")),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("neg", "pos"))
    )

LC3_stats
```

ANOVA
```{r}
model <- aov(FC ~ Group * Condition, data = data_LC3_subset)
summary(model)
```

##########################################################################################
ORGANELLES (Figure 4D/E/F)
##########################################################################################

Organelles - Number (Normalised).csv
Organelles - Object Intensity (Normalised).csv
Organelles - Size (Normalised).csv

Function to read in organelle data and pivot long
```{r}
# READ IN ORGANELLE DATA
read_organelle_data <- function(csv_file){
  df <- as.data.frame(t(csv_file))
  colnames(df) <- df[1,]
  df <- df[-1,]
  
  df <- df %>%
    rownames_to_column("Group") %>%
    mutate(Group = case_when(
      str_starts(Group, "Expi.ULK1.KO") ~ "Expi_ULK1_KO",
      str_starts(Group, "Expi") ~ "Expi",
      TRUE ~ Group)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols=!c("Group"), names_to = "Protein", values_to = "Measurement") %>%
    mutate(Measurement = as.double(gsub(",", ".", Measurement))) %>%
    mutate(Measurement = as.double(Measurement))  
  return(df)
}

# GET SD, SEM, MEAN OF ORGANELLE DATA
make_plot_df <- function(df){
  df_plot <- df %>%
    group_by(Group, Protein) %>%
    reframe(mean = mean(Measurement),
            sd = sd(Measurement),
            sem = sd(Measurement) /sqrt(length(Measurement)),
            Group_Prot = paste0(Group, "_", "Protein")) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Expi","Expi_ULK1_KO"))) %>%
    mutate(Protein = factor(Protein, levels = c("EEA1", "LAMP1", "TOM20", "GM130", "CANX")))
  return(df_plot)
}

# CALCULATE PVAL ORGANELLE DATA
get_pvals <- function(df){
  p_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Protein) %>%
    t_test(Measurement ~ Group, paired = FALSE, comparisons = list(c("Expi", "Expi_ULK1_KO")))
  return(p_df)
}

```

Plot organelles
```{r}
plot_organelles <- function(df, df_points, set_title, set_y){
    
  condition_colors <- c("Expi" = "#9bd1ae", "Expi_ULK1_KO" = "#98b5eb")
  condition_labels <- c("Expi" = "Expi", "Expi_ULK1_KO" = "Expi ULK1 KO")
  
  organelle_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x=Protein, y = mean, fill = Group, group = Group)) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = position_dodge(width=0.6),
           width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem,
                      ymax = mean + sem),
                  position = position_dodge(0.6), width = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors,
                      labels = condition_labels) +
    labs(title = set_title,
         x = "",
         y = set_y,
         fill = "") +
    geom_point(data = df_points,
             aes(x = Protein, y = Measurement, fill = Group, group = Group),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.6),
             color = "black", size = 0.6) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1.25)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
      theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
      )
  organelle_plot
}
```


# Get all organelles
```{r}
org_intesity <- read.csv("../data/validation_data/prism_v2/Organelles - Object Intensity (Normalised).csv", sep=";", header = TRUE)

# INTENSITY - NORMALIZED
```
